text:
ella: Hey team — hitting an error when calling the rerank endpoint. We send a query + ~300 docs and the API returns a 400 with "Input too large". Customer expects a clear reason (token vs char vs doc count).

maria: sorry you're seeing that, can you paste the curl you used and the exact error payload? also customer id/email?

ella: repro snippet (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/relevance/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"query":"'"'very long user query... '"'", "documents":["<long html blob>", "<long html blob>", ... 300 items]}'
```
Response: 400 {"error":"Input too large","message":"request body exceeds allowed limits"}

maria: thanks. that error is too generic. we need to know: is it docs count, total tokens, or single-doc length? customer tried truncating doc text and still hit it.

repro-bot: automated note: ran local tokenization (tiktoken-like) on the provided docs — total tokens ~ 78,000; max documented rerank limit is 25k tokens for this model variant.

ajay (SRE): that matches. runtime currently enforces both a max_docs=500 and max_total_tokens=25000 (per request) but the error path bubbles up as a 400 with generic message. we should map checks to specific error codes and messages.

ella: can we get a suggested message to send customers? They paused integration.

maria: propose a support-friendly reply: "Your rerank request exceeded our input limits (either number of documents, total tokens, or per-document length). Suggested fixes: 1) reduce number of documents passed to rerank, 2) truncate or summarize long documents client-side, 3) split work into batches. If you want, share sample docs and we can triage." but we should add exact numeric limits per model.

lucas (PM): urgent: customers keep getting confused between characters and tokens. we should include both and example guidance: e.g. "approx tokens = chars / 4 for English as a rough rule" and sample client-side code for pre-checking. add links to KB.

sophia (Eng): engineer notes: two things — runtime enforces a tokenized limit (25000) and a JSON payload size limit (~4MB) from the http layer. Long HTML can be large in bytes but not that many tokens if compressed; however for this case tokens are the problem. Also there are separate per-document limits (we cap single doc to 8192 tokens to avoid pathological scoring).

maria: actionable: can eng change the error payloads? Current canonical error is: `{"error":"Input too large","message":"request body exceeds allowed limits"}`. I'd like something like: `{"error":"RERANK_TOO_LARGE", "reason":"total_tokens_exceeded", "details":"total_tokens=78600 max_total_tokens=25000"}` so we can surface precise guidance to customers.

sophia (Eng): +1. we can add a machine-friendly code and a human message. Implementation effort: small, but need tests and backfill for older clients. will file a PR.

ajay (SRE): also consider HTTP status: 413 (Payload Too Large) is used by infra for bytes; for token quotas 400 is fine but add code. don't change semantics for existing SDK error handling without a deprecation window.

lucas (PM): timeline? customer is blocked now, needs interim support message.

maria: interim support template (short): "We're seeing a token-limit hit on your rerank request. Try reducing docs per request to <= 100 or summarize/truncate long docs. If you need help batch-splitting we can provide a script." (we'll update once eng returns exact limits).

ella: can you share the batch-splitting script?

maria: quick python example to split by tokens: 
```python
# naive split by chars -> tokens approx chars/4
def split_docs(docs, max_tokens=25000, approx_token_per_char=0.25):
    batches = []
    cur = []
    cur_tokens = 0
    for d in docs:
        t = max(1, int(len(d) * approx_token_per_char))
        if cur_tokens + t > max_tokens:
            batches.append(cur)
            cur = [d]
            cur_tokens = t
        else:
            cur.append(d)
            cur_tokens += t
    if cur: batches.append(cur)
    return batches
```

ella: that helped, thanks. ran split and can proceed. customer still wants clearer error msgs so they can self-triage.

sophia (Eng): PR created: add RERANK_TOO_LARGE with reason keys (total_tokens_exceeded, per_doc_tokens_exceeded, docs_count_exceeded, payload_bytes_exceeded). Will add tests and a changelog entry. tagging @ajay for infra review.

ajay (SRE): ack — will review infra implications. please include fallbacks so handlers that only look for status codes still see 400/413 as appropriate.

maria: after PR merges: update KB article + canned support templates + SDK exceptions mapping. lucas can you coordinate KB copy?

lucas (PM): on it. I'll draft KB with examples (curl, python split, approximate token->char heuristics, checklist to triage). ETA EOD tomorrow.

ella: thank you all — please ping here once error messages are updated so I can notify the customer.

sophia (Eng): will post PR link + deploy window here when scheduled.

repro-bot: note: added automated check to internal repro harness to record total_tokens in logs for future threads.

maria: closing loop for now. tagging support-runbook update in our backlog. :white_check_mark:

ella: resolved for now, will re-open if customer sees anything else.
